text.p: -- Alex. Brown said it downgraded Oakley Inc to buy from strong buy.

-- Alex. Brown analyst Marcia Aaron said the downgrade reflects inventory cutting at a large retailer of sunglasses, Sunglass Hut Inc. Last week, Sunglass Hut warned of lower third quarter earnings. Aaron said that company will be reducing inventory over the next six to eight weeks.
-- Aaron said Sunglass Hut's activity will hurt Oakley, a maker of sunglasses, in the near term, but she continues to look for an "absolutely terrific" Spring and Summer 1997.
-- She maintains a 1996 full year estimate of $0.75 a share for the company and a 1997 full year estimate of $0.94 a share.
